@fliwright/core.responsibility: Own the reusable TypeScript automation domain, VM-service client protocol, and shared models used by every integration.

@fliwright/vitest.responsibility: Adapt the core runtime to Vitest fixtures, hooks, configuration, reporting, and test lifecycle behavior.

@fliwright/plugin-riverpod.responsibility: Provide the core-side plugin and StateAdapter that consume the Dart Riverpod bridge surface.

@fliwright/tdd.responsibility: Own persistent TDD execution, baseline reset, focused reruns, red-first generation, and repair planning.

@fliwright/cli.responsibility: Expose operator-facing command-line workflows and reusable command capabilities backed by core and TDD.

@fliwright/mcp.responsibility: Expose agent-facing MCP tools and resources that adapt CLI, TDD, and core capabilities.

fliwright-vscode.responsibility: Own VS Code commands, views, webviews, and project workflows that consume public package capabilities.

@fliwright/e2e-tests.responsibility: Verify public Fliwright behavior against running Flutter applications through smoke and integration tests.
doesNotOwn: shared test fixtures for package consumers

fliwright_bridge.responsibility: Run inside Flutter applications and expose ext.fliwright.* VM-service methods for inspection, control, capture, recording, and mocks.

fliwright_bridge_riverpod.responsibility: Observe Riverpod lifecycle and expose provider state through the base Flutter bridge.

form_demo.responsibility: Exercise form filling and HTTP mock behavior as a consumer of the public Flutter bridge.

go_router_demo.responsibility: Exercise navigation and form behavior as a consumer of the public Flutter bridge.

riverpod_demo.responsibility: Exercise bridge and Riverpod adapter behavior as a consumer of public Flutter packages.
